name: Jethro
overview: Scripture introduces Jethro, also called Reuel or Raguel, as the priest of Midian whose seven daughters encountered Moses after he fled Egypt. Moses defended them against shepherds and was invited by Jethro to share a meal, marking the beginning of his forty-year exile in Midian where he married one of Jethro's daughters. This account highlights Jethro's role as a hospitable and influential figure in Moses' life during a critical period of preparation.
